# Hawiyat
> AI infrastructure platform — the execution layer between frontier AI models and business systems. Hawiyat AI Composer decides the best way to accomplish each task: which model to route to, what context to carry, and whether the result is good enough.

This optional file helps compatible non-Google systems discover Hawiyat's main public pages. Google Search does not use llms.txt as a ranking signal. See /llmsfull.txt for full details (every service, pricing in DZD, features, and FAQs).

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.hawiyat.org/): The execution layer between frontier AI models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, open models) and the systems businesses run — WhatsApp, CRM, ERP, email, databases, workflows.
- [Hawiyat AI Composer](https://www.hawiyat.org/composer): The AI execution engine — every task runs UNDERSTAND → PLAN → ROUTE → EXECUTE → EVALUATE → RESULT, model-agnostic, evaluated, and priced in DZD.
- [Services](https://www.hawiyat.org/services): Hawiyat AI Composer plans, n8n hosting, Evolution API (WhatsApp infrastructure), and application hosting — all billed in Algerian dinars.
- [FAQ](https://www.hawiyat.org/faq): Questions and answers about Hawiyat AI Composer, pricing in DZD, payments, and data.
- [About Hawiyat](https://www.hawiyat.org/about): Company, team, credentials, and Algeria presence.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.hawiyat.org/terms): Legal terms for the Hawiyat platform and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.hawiyat.org/privacy): How Hawiyat collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [DMCA](https://www.hawiyat.org/dmca): Copyright notice and counter-notice policy.

## Important facts
- Hawiyat is an AI provider based in Algeria: an AI infrastructure platform and the execution layer between frontier AI models and business systems.
- Hawiyat is based in Algeria and supports customers in Arabic, French, and English.
- Billing is in Algerian dinars (DZD); local payment methods CCP and Baridi Mob are accepted.
- Models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, open models) are routes on the execution layer, never sold as SKUs or credits. Hawiyat does not resell or rebrand any model.
- Hawiyat does not imply an official partnership with any model provider unless explicitly stated; third-party product and model names belong to their respective owners.

## Common questions
- What is Hawiyat? An AI infrastructure platform, the execution layer between frontier AI models and business systems. Hawiyat AI Composer decides the best way to accomplish each task: which model to route to, what context to carry, and whether the result is good enough.
- Is Hawiyat available in Algeria? Yes. Hawiyat is based in Algeria, supports Arabic, French, and English, and bills in Algerian dinars (DZD) with CCP and Baridi Mob.
- What does Hawiyat AI Composer cost in DZD? Pro is 6,000 DA/month, MAX 5X is 15,000 DA/month, MAX 20X is 30,000 DA/month; Enterprise is custom-priced, billed in DZD. See pricing.md for the full list.
- What is n8n hosting in Algeria? Managed n8n automation hosted by Hawiyat, priced in DZD: Freelance 8,000 DA/year, Startup 30,000 DA/year, Enterprise 80,000 DA/year.
- Am I locked into one AI model? No. Models are routes, chosen per task by quality, latency, and cost. GPT, Claude, Gemini, and open models all sit behind the same layer, so a provider change never breaks your pipeline. The layer outlives any single model.
- Can I pay without a foreign card? Yes, everything is billed in DZD. Pay with CCP or Baridi Mob, no foreign card needed.
- Why not just use ChatGPT or a chatbot? A chatbot answers a prompt. Composer executes a business task: it pulls your customer and order context, picks the best model for the job, runs it against your systems, and checks the result before it reaches anyone. Same engines, but the layer decides the how.
- Can Composer work with my WhatsApp? Yes, WhatsApp is a first-class route on the layer. Support, sales, and back-office runs happen there, and a workflow can be executing the same day you order.
